error.HUB_PACKAGE_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED: This Hub package schema version is unsupported. Update the reader before importing.
error.HUB_ENVELOPE_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED: This Hub signature envelope version is unsupported.
error.HUB_FEED_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED: This Hub revocation feed version is unsupported.
error.HUB_PACKAGE_INVALID: The Hub package does not match its versioned contract.
error.HUB_ENVELOPE_INVALID: The Hub signature envelope is invalid or has duplicate roles.
error.HUB_FEED_INVALID: The Hub revocation feed or its verification context is invalid.
error.HUB_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The Hub input exceeds a registry limit.
error.HUB_DIGEST_MISMATCH: The Hub content differs from its signed digest or size.
error.HUB_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The Hub signature could not be verified.
error.HUB_SIGNER_UNTRUSTED: The Hub signing key is unknown, inactive or does not match the selected trust anchor. Nothing was installed. If you trust this publisher, register its public key as an import key on your own terminal (deckent agents add-signer --input <file> with purpose "import"), then try again.
error.HUB_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: The Hub identity differs from the pinned source: hubId must be the SHA-256 (64 hex) of the hub's public key. Check both with the hub's operator; nothing was changed.
error.HUB_FOREIGN_PACKAGE: The package has no matching attestation from the selected Hub.
error.HUB_FEED_REPLAYED: The Hub revocation feed is older or has already been accepted.
error.HUB_FEED_STALE: The signed Hub revocation feed is expired or has a future timestamp. Refresh it before continuing.
error.HUB_SKILL_INVALID: The skill content or its package frontmatter is invalid.
error.HUB_SERVER_DENIED: The Hub operation is outside this principal or scope authority.
error.HUB_VERSION_CONFLICT: A published Hub version is immutable; publish a strictly newer version.
error.HUB_DEPENDENCY_INVALID: The exact Hub dependency closure is missing, foreign, cyclic or over its bound.
error.HUB_SECRET_REFUSED: The Hub package contains secret material and cannot be published.
error.HUB_REVIEW_REFUSED: The Hub reviewer is not eligible for this countersignature.
error.HUB_STORE_UNSAFE: The Hub store identity, schema or filesystem custody is unsafe.
error.HUB_STORE_CONFLICT: The Hub store changed; inspect the current revision before a new action.
error.HUB_RESOURCE_UNKNOWN: The requested Hub skill or resource does not exist.
error.HUB_STORE_UNSUPPORTED: This platform cannot enforce the Hub filesystem storage boundary.
error.HUB_STORE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The Hub transaction outcome is unknown. Reconcile retained evidence before any new action.
error.HUB_SOURCE_INVALID: The Hub source is invalid: publicKey must be the hub's Ed25519 public key (base64 SPKI); endpoint an https URL (http only with "local": true) or an absolute folder path, without user, password or #. Or the source limit was reached. Nothing was added. Fields: deckent hub sources add --schema
error.HUB_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND: The selected Hub source is absent or removed.
error.HUB_AUTHORITY_REFUSED: This Hub operation requires the person card or an active signing key and grant.
error.HUB_INSTALL_CONFLICT: The Hub command or catalog revision conflicts with stored state. Inspect it before retrying.
error.HUB_DEPENDENCY_REFUSED: The exact dependency closure or local WorkClass mapping could not be verified.
error.HUB_DOWNGRADE_REFUSED: An update must select a strictly higher package version.
error.HUB_PACKAGE_REVOKED: This package, publisher or signing key was withdrawn by the signed Hub feed.
error.HUB_STORE_CORRUPT: Hub storage failed integrity validation. Preserve the evidence and inspect the ledger.
error.HUB_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The Hub commit result is unknown. Reconcile using the same command id.
error.HUB_FILE_UNSUPPORTED: Secure Hub file import is unavailable on this platform.
error.HUB_SKILL_FILES_UNAVAILABLE: Supporting-file delivery is unavailable on this worker sandbox. A sandbox that enforces read-only, noexec file mounts is required before admitting another Run.
error.HUB_TLS_REQUIRED: TLS certificate and key are required before binding a Hub outside loopback.
error.HUB_NETWORK_INVALID: The Hub network configuration or request is invalid.
error.HUB_NETWORK_FAILED: The Hub network request failed. Inspect its effect evidence before retrying.
error.HUB_FIRST_USE_REQUIRED: Approve the person’s first-use Hub card before connecting.

hub.tool.revoke: Revoke a Hub version through its signed feed.
hub.revocation.withdrawn: Hub content or signed-feed freshness could not be verified. Its installed items are withheld from new agent selection. Inspect the source and refresh; admitted Runs keep their frozen agent.
hub.revocation.restored: A fresh verified Hub feed cleared the freshness withdrawal. Your standing changes remain in effect.
hub.revocation.revoked: The signed Hub feed revoked installed content. It is excluded from new agent selection. Inspect the package before choosing a replacement.
hub.revocation.yanked: The Hub withdrew this content from new installation. Existing use continues.
hub.help.summary: Manage signed Hub packages and sources.
hub.help:
Usage: deckent hub <action>
  sources [list|add|remove] | search | inspect | install | update | uninstall | verify | export | refresh | cards | publish | yank | revoke
  [--input <file|->] [--scope <id>] [--json] [--schema]
Use --schema to inspect the input of an operation. Package bundles travel as base64 .deckentpkg bytes. Writes need the person’s interactive card; MCP uses its own signed authority. No source or network connection is enabled automatically.

hub.card.body: Review the exact scope, source, trust policy and content below. Installing does not grant tools or standing. Adding a source does not approve the first network connection. Closing after submission does not undo a committed change.

error.HUB_ACCOUNT_REFUSED: Hub login or publishing requires an active verified account, a passkey and the configured minimum account age.
error.HUB_PROFILE_REFUSED: The Hub profile, handle or key proof is invalid or inactive.
